aiReports.title: Orchard Link Structural Deformation Insight
aiReports.summary: Automated laser sensors detected a sudden road shift at Sector 4, Orchard Rd. Structural deformation threshold exceeded by 180%.
aiReports.aiInsights: Crews should proceed to Orchard Link immediately. Recommend emergency detour routing and capping sector speeds at 30km/h.
